breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect instructions: 'The pure-bending normal stress is treated as uniform over the section depth' and 'The stress at the neutral axis has the same sign as at the extreme fibers.' These erroneous statements from the incomplete prompt were carried over verbatim. The ground truth removes these instructions entirely, allowing the standard flexure formula (linear distribution, zero stress at neutral axis) to apply correctly. Although the generated spec later mentions σ = My/I, the explicit retention of the uniform-stress instruction means the inconsistency was not resolved.
